// diagnostic

L1141

Autodiff transform result called inline; bind the derivative before calling it (D-COMPUTE-GRAD1=E)

What

Autodiff transform result called inline; bind the derivative before calling it (D-COMPUTE-GRAD1=E)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for L1141

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L1141: tests/ui_lint/compute_transform_inline.warn.

Warning [L1141] (inline_autodiff): an autodiff transform result is called inline
  --> tests/ui_lint/compute_transform_inline.jet:8:25
    |
  8 |     (dw, dx) :: compute.gradient(loss).call(w, x)
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the transform arity returns a callable; inline calls make it unclear whether a direct gradient or a derivative function was requested
 Fix: bind the derivative first, then call the binding: `d_loss :: compute.gradient(loss)`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L1141
